description: Expected results for the official CSDMS BMI heat example (csdms/bmi-example-python, commit 0701609, bmi-heat 2.1.3.dev0): examples/heat.yaml (6x8 plate, spacing 1, alpha 1) driven by the official notebook examples/run-model-from-bmi.ipynb -- set a 100 K spike in the plate centre, run 10 steps of dt=0.25 s. The same case is also run through the KI tools/bmi_runner.py, the KI tools/compliance_checker.py is run on BmiHeat, and the 28 upstream unit tests (tests/*.py) are called. inputs/ are the unmodified upstream files. The notebook ships with no stored outputs and the repo has no reference output files, so values were recorded from our own run; two clean runs gave identical numbers and a byte-identical KI runner CSV (the case is deterministic: the spike set_value overwrites the random start field).

numeric_checks.name: nb_n_steps
numeric_checks.why: notebook runs one update, then updates until t = 10 dt

numeric_checks.name: nb_center_after_1_step
numeric_checks.why: centre value after the first step (100 K spike spreads)

numeric_checks.name: nb_final_max
numeric_checks.why: plate maximum after 10 steps (still at the centre)

numeric_checks.name: nb_final_sum
numeric_checks.why: the notebook's last printed number: temperature_flat.sum() (heat lost at the edges, so < 100)

numeric_checks.name: ki_runner_n_steps
numeric_checks.why: KI bmi_runner.run_model with end_time 2.5 and spike injected at t=0

numeric_checks.name: ki_runner_final_sum
numeric_checks.why: KI runner final mean x 48 must equal the notebook sum

numeric_checks.name: ki_compliance_implemented
numeric_checks.why: KI compliance_checker: BmiHeat has 41 of the 42 functions it lists; the one missing is get_bmi_version, which is BMI 2.1 and not part of BMI 2.0 that this heat version and bmipy 2.0.1 follow

numeric_checks.name: upstream_tests_passed
numeric_checks.why: all 28 upstream unit tests (get_value 6, grid_info 11, irf 9, set_value 2) pass

extra_check: KI runner final sum must match the notebook final sum to 1e-9; engine worker must exit 0
recorded_with: /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/BMI/venv/bin/python (bmi-heat installed from git), notebook cells run as-is (the one '!cat heat.yaml' shell line skipped), KI tools from models/BMI/tools
reference: Own run, repeated twice with identical results. No official reference outputs exist (notebook saved without outputs; repo has no reference files).
notes: Run-time only tweak (no file changed): the server venv's heat package lost heat/__init__.py, so run_reference sets heat.BmiHeat = heat.bmi_heat.BmiHeat before the notebook and tests run. This only restores the name the package's own __init__.py would export; the model code is the same.
